correctness.rationale: All mixed nonempty Abelian squares in a^p b^q a^r b^s must cross either three run boundaries (outer equal partial lengths and even center run), or all four with one of the two allowed midpoint placements and parity restriction. Inclusion–exclusion subtracts only the repeated a^r b^q a^r b^q word, yielding seven-term exact formula. For fixed letter populations A,B>=4, monochromatic square counts give H(A)+H(B) apart from at most two odd-balanced deficiencies; explicit distinct mixed squares compensate each deficiency, while effective odd interior run construction attains the bound. Independent direct literal-factor enumerator agreed for every 7^4=2401 tuples with run lengths 1..7.
residual_risks: Finite cross-checks are corroboration, not universal proof.
